WG Agent-supported editor: cycle 2026-11-10 11:30 to 2026-11-11 11:30 UTC

Can an essay container declare its comments and references as children so one export carries the whole essay, while agents can still file comments (srs-web#634)? Why it matters: two of your rulings collide. Options: A engine guard stops at declared children; B keep the snapshot bundle, widened to carry threads; C another path for agent comments; D nothing. 2. Decided within mandate: none this cycle; no group session was held (no `proposed` decision in the group log, so nothing ready to ratify). Owner rulings this cycle: none new in the log.
3. Done: 7 PRs merged, all by the owner account. With a quorum line (builder / reviewer / mandate): srs-web#784 (image paragraph reading view; human:the-greenman / agent:editor-reviewer / 384a704a with c4cc4697, b2b5c488, 72bcd83e, 866167c1), srs-web#783 (no markdown images in normal paragraphs; same pair / 2ec3671d), srs-rust#1616 (markdown render option to drop images; same pair / 2ec3671d), srs-rust#1618 (refuse unsafe SVG at attach; same pair / 866167c1). Without a quorum comment: srs-web#778 (pin bindings to build 643), #776 (essay help on markdown), #789 (bug: essays tray counts and picker).
4. Stuck or lost: srs-web#790 (visual paragraph editing surface) is open with a reviewer reject: remedy ecc44c03 is not yet affirmed, so there is no merge mandate; no other finding. srs-web#792 (insert and edit an image paragraph) is open, no review yet. The three merges without a quorum line are noted as a gap in the record. No red gates reported. Needs-input: srs-web#709, #626, #634, #567. Blocked: srs-web#750 to #752, #766, #768, #771, #791, #426, semanticops.com#14. No escalated owner ruling is missing from both logs.
5. Budget: 0 of 10 delegated merges counted by the clerk for the window starting 11:30 today (the 4 auto-merge PRs landed earlier in the cycle, before that window); 2 open. Pause: running.
5b. Awaiting ratification: none.
6. Next: ready + wg:agent-editor: srs-web#634 and #626 (both needs-input), #601 (an umbrella); semanticops.com#57 and #59 (a spike), #14 (blocked). Top 3 in builder order: srs-web#601, semanticops.com#57, #59. Open group PRs in flight: srs-web#790, #792. Budget left: 10. Queue running dry: about 4 ready that a builder can take, against a budget of 10. Needs feeding: the image chain (srs-web#766, #791) and visual editing (#750 to #752) wait on #790 and #792; other sources are the drift list and open exercises. Waits on you: the #634 decision, the #709 answer, affirming remedy ecc44c03. Local priorities: none set. Fed by the analyst: not needed this cycle (last editor run 2026-11-08).
6b. Exercises: none open.
7. What we learned: the image holon flowed once its remedy was affirmed (four PRs merged on one day under rulings 2ec3671d and 866167c1), and the visual-editing chain stopped at the same gate with remedy ecc44c03: affirming a remedy is the owner's one lever on throughput. Three merges carried no quorum line (#778, #776, #789), so small PRs bypass the quorum record; worth a standing-order note. I1 (written at this close, 0cba8a54-1349-4ea3-a7dc-fd77cea96725): 1/4 grounded to a problem (25%) and 1/4 with persona and domain, for the window from 11:30 today; the useful/noisy/misleading line is yours to give in a session.
